name: UI/UX Designer
summary: Researches user needs and designs usable interfaces, delivering flows and UI specs for engineering teams.
whatTheyDo: Map journeys, wireframe and prototype interfaces, run lightweight research, and hand off consistent design systems.
responsibilities: Validate assumptions with research when possible
careerTransitions: Can specialize in UX research or design systems
bangladeshNotes: UI/UX and Product Designer titles appear in Bangladesh product companies and agencies; Figma is the dominant tool signal in portfolios and ads. Some software firms combine UI design with frontend expectations—clarify role scope before applying. Avoid assuming every engineering employer has a dedicated design team.
commonQualifications: Case studies showing process, not only visuals
experienceExpectations: Junior roles may accept strong portfolios; product companies often want shipped-app case studies.
